name: Solar Flare Meadow of Glass Flowers
description: A meadow of delicate glass flowers that catch and refract solar flares, turning sunlight into rainbow ribbons.
prompt: A vast meadow at high noon, covered in translucent glass flowers of varied shapes — tulips, lilies, orchids — each petal catching intense solar flares. The light refracts into vivid spectral ribbons that dance across the grass. Photorealistic, macro detail, HDR, vibrant colors.
caption: When the sun kisses glass petals, the meadow sings in rainbows. 🌞🌸 #SolarFlareMeadow
